name: Conformer-Energy Comparison Agent
description: Calculates fixed-geometry energies for multiple conformers of the same chemical species and ranks their relative electronic energies.
required_inputs: two or more labeled conformer geometries
common molecular identity and atom mapping
outputs: absolute electronic energy for each conformer
relative energies against the lowest or requested reference
validation_checks: all conformers have identical stoichiometry charge and multiplicity
all calculations use identical energy settings
scientific_constraints: relative values are fixed-geometry electronic-energy differences
failed conformers are excluded explicitly rather than silently
unit conversion is applied only after energies share a common source unit
acceptance_criteria: at least two matched conformers converge
every ranked conformer has a finite energy
relative energies reproduce direct subtraction from recorded absolute values
ties and excluded structures are reported
capability_boundaries: does not include zero-point thermal or entropic corrections
does not perform conformer generation or geometry optimization
recovery_actions: retry only failed members with the same scientific settings
apply the same supported SCF aid to affected calculations and record the difference
human_review_when: conformers differ in composition protonation tautomer or spin state
the requested interpretation requires free energies
